usedFor: Gtwy runs your AI apps and Google Docs keeps notes, so “Error Alert” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Error Alert” in Gtwy, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each error is written into a doc tab, which gives you one log to review.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace the tab's content, so set it to add to keep earlier errors.
